By assuming the required data was missing and failing to read the page content (or verify the link) before deciding to stop searching or pivot, the Planner caused a premature termination of the information gathering process, leading to an incorrect final answer. This assumption prevented the agent from finding the specific fact that 'Burn' was the lead single and stuck in the top 10 for 8 weeks.
